g1|variants|inquiry and quotation.summary: This family covers standard, value-based, and quantity-based pre-sales inquiry and quotation scenarios in SAP S/4HANA Sales. Variants differ by document types, pricing relevance, validity periods, and whether they lead to subsequent sales orders or contracts.

variants.name: Standard Inquiry
variants.when_used: Customer requests general pricing and availability information without binding commitment.
variants.key_config: Sales document type IN configured with transaction flow control pointing to quotation type QT or order type OR.

variants.name: Standard Quotation
variants.when_used: Binding offer issued to a customer with fixed prices and quantities for a specific validity period.
variants.key_config: Sales document type QT configured for pricing, availability check, and copy control to standard order OR.

variants.name: Value-Based Quotation
variants.when_used: Offering a total monetary budget or value limit rather than specific material quantities.
variants.key_config: Item category AGTN configured for value contracts with target value checks and specific copy controls.

variants.name: Free-of-Charge Quotation
variants.when_used: Offering promotional samples or trial items at no cost as part of a pre-sales campaign.
variants.key_config: Item category TQR assigned with pricing procedure exclusion or automatic 100% pricing condition type.

g1|core|inquiry and quotation|standard q.title: Standard Quotation in SAP Order-to-Cash
g1|core|inquiry and quotation|standard q.story: A quotation is like a restaurant menu with guaranteed prices that stay the same for a whole month, letting the customer order knowing exactly what they will pay. In SAP S/4HANA, the Standard Quotation (sales document type QT) holds legally binding pricing and delivery terms for a defined validity period, allowing conversion into a standard sales order (OR) without re-entering master data.
g1|core|inquiry and quotation|standard q.why_business_needs_it: Businesses need quotations to make formal, time-bound offers to customers while protecting profit margins against cost fluctuations during the negotiation phase. It tracks sales pipeline opportunities and streamlines downstream fulfillment once the customer accepts the offer.

g1|core|inquiry and quotation|value-base.title: Value-Based Quotation
g1|core|inquiry and quotation|value-base.story: Imagine a big toy store promising a company a special price and budget limit for toy purchases over the next year, writing it all down on a giant proposal sheet. In SAP Order-to-Cash (OTC), a Value-Based Quotation (Sales Document Type CQ) is a formal sales proposal that establishes a target value and pricing validity period for a customer, which can later be referenced to create a Value Contract (WK1) or standard sales order without losing the agreed target value.
g1|core|inquiry and quotation|value-base.why_business_needs_it: A business needs value-based quotations to commit to specific financial ceilings and agreed pricing terms for high-value customers over a defined validity period. This ensures pricing consistency and prevents sales representatives from granting unauthorized discounts when converting the proposal into a downstream contract or order.

modules.role: Owns the entire quotation lifecycle, pricing determination, validity date checks, and downstream sales document creation.

g1|core|inquiry and quotation|free-of-ch.title: Free-of-Charge Quotation Processing
g1|core|inquiry and quotation|free-of-ch.story: Imagine asking a store if they can give you a free sample, and the clerk writes down a special promise on a paper that says they will give it to you without charging money if you accept it before a certain date. In SAP S/4HANA Order-to-Cash, a free-of-charge quotation creates a legally binding offer with a 100% discount, mandatory validity dates, and zero net value that can later be converted into a free-of-charge sales order without generating customer invoices.
g1|core|inquiry and quotation|free-of-ch.why_business_needs_it: The business needs this to formally offer promotional materials, replacement samples, or goodwill items to customers under strict validity controls and audit trails without triggering financial accounts receivable. Proper configuration ensures that pricing routines assign a 100% discount automatically while prohibiting billing document creation downstream.

modules.role: Manages quotation creation, free-of-charge item categories, pricing condition exclusions, validity checks, and the copy control to subsequent free-of-charge orders.
modules.hands_off_to: FI-AR (Financial Accounting - Accounts Receivable) and Billing (when zero-value billing block prevents posting).

modules.role: Performs availability checks (ATP) and confirms material stock for the free-of-charge quotation and resulting delivery.
modules.hands_off_to: LE-SHP (Logistics Execution - Shipping) for outbound delivery processing.

prerequisites: Customer Master Data (Sold-to Party, Ship-to Party) created with sales area views via XD01 or BP
Material Master Data (Trading Goods or Finished Goods) with MRP and Sales views via MM01
Pricing Procedure configuration and condition records for standard discounts via VK11
Shipping Point Determination and Plant Assignment via OVXC

config_steps.step: Define Sales Document Type for Free-of-Charge Quotation
config_steps.where: VOV8 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Sales Documents Header > Define Sales Document Types
config_steps.values: Sales Doc Type ZQT: internal range 02, external range 03, ref mandatory C, check division X
config_steps.check: Run transaction SE16N for table TVAK and verify entry ZQT exists.
config_steps.why: This step creates the high-level control container in sales administration that dictates how quotation documents behave, which document numbers they pull, and how they interact with subsequent free-of-charge sales orders.
config_steps.if_missing: If this configuration is missing, users cannot create free-of-charge quotations because the system throws message V1018 "Sales document type ZQT does not exist".
actions: Enter transaction code /nVOV8 in the command field and press Enter.
Select standard sales document type QT (Quotation) and click Copy As (F6).
Overwrite Sales Document Type with ZQT and Description with Free-of-Charge Quotation.
Set Number range internal to 02 and Number range external to 03 in the Number Assignment section.
Set Ref. mandatory to C (Reference mandatory) to ensure validity dates and terms are copied.
Verify Item increment is 10 and Subitem increment is 10.
Check division to X and ensure Billing block is blank.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and assign the configuration to a transport request.

fields.note: Custom sales document type for free-of-charge quotation
Forces reference to preceding document or inquiry
Enforces division consistency between customer and material

config_steps.step: Define Item Category for Free-of-Charge Quotation
config_steps.where: VOV7 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Sales Document Item > Define Item Categories
config_steps.values: Item category ZTQR: pricing blank, billing relevance K, determine cost X, statistical value X
config_steps.check: Run transaction SE16N on table TVOZ to confirm item category ZTQR attributes.
config_steps.why: This activity establishes the item-level behavior, ensuring that items added to the quotation carry zero net value while still maintaining delivery relevance and cost tracking.
config_steps.if_missing: Without item category ZTQR, quotation line items default to standard pricing behavior, causing free samples to incorrectly calculate full customer invoices. System issues message V1022.
actions: Enter transaction code /nVOV7 in the command field and press Enter.
Select standard item category TAN (Standard Item) and click Copy As (F6).
Overwrite Item Category with ZTQR and Description with Free-of-Charge Quotation Item.
Leave Pricing field blank so that price conditions are not relevant for billing value calculation.
Set Billing relevance to K (Delivery-relevant billing - no line items / zero value).
Set Item type to Standard item and Completion rule to A (Reference mandatory).
Check Determine cost to X and Statistical value to X.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and confirm the transport request.

fields.note: Blank to prevent net value generation
Allows cost analysis in profitability reporting
Marks item value as statistical for credit and reporting

config_steps.step: Assign Item Categories for Free-of-Charge Quotation
config_steps.where: VOV4 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Sales Document Item > Assign Item Categories
config_steps.values: Assignment: Sales Doc Type ZQT + Item Cat Group NORM -> Default Item Category ZTQR
config_steps.check: Create a test quotation via VA21 using material with group NORM and check item category determination in item details.
config_steps.why: This determination rule automatically links the custom quotation header type with the zero-value item category whenever a standard trading good is added to the document.
config_steps.if_missing: If unassigned, the system cannot determine which item category to use, resulting in error message V1312 "No item category exists (Table TVEP)".
actions: Enter transaction code /nVOV4 in the command field and press Enter.
Click New Entries in the application toolbar.
Enter Sales Doc. Type as ZQT.
Enter Item Category Group as NORM (Material default).
Leave Higher Level Item Category blank.
Enter Default Item Category as ZTQR.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and save your entries to the customizing transport request.

config_steps.step: Define Pricing Procedure and Condition Type for 100% Discount
config_steps.where: V/08 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Pricing > Pricing Control > Define And Assign Pricing Procedures
config_steps.values: Condition Type ZR10: calculation type A, condition class D, plus/minus negative
config_steps.check: Check pricing procedure analysis in a quotation to ensure ZR10 applies a full 100% deduction.
config_steps.why: This pricing element ensures that even if material prices exist in master data, the quotation systematically nets them down to zero value for audit and compliance purposes.
config_steps.if_missing: Without this condition type, free quotations would pick up standard list prices, charging the customer unexpectedly and breaking the free-of-charge business promise.
actions: Enter transaction code /nV/08 in the command field and press Enter.
Select condition type R100 (100% Discount Free Goods) or click New Entries to create ZR10.
Set Calculation Type to A (Percentage).
Set Condition Class to D (Discounts or Surcharges).
Set Plus/Minus to Negative (-).
Verify Condition category is set to Free goods.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and confirm transport release.

fields.note: Negative sign to reduce net value to zero

config_steps.step: Define Copy Control for Sales Documents from Quotation to Order
config_steps.where: VTLA -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Define Copy Control for Sales Documents
config_steps.screen_title: Change View "Copy Control Sales Document to Sales Document": Item Overview
config_steps.values: Copy Control ZQT to OR: item routine 002, copy quantity X, positive sign
config_steps.check: Execute transaction VA01 referencing a free-of-charge quotation and verify items copy seamlessly into the sales order.
config_steps.why: This copy control linkage bridges the legally binding sales offer to the execution phase, enabling seamless downstream processing into orders and deliveries without manual data re-entry.
config_steps.if_missing: If copy control rules are missing, attempting to reference the quotation in VA01 results in error message V4301 "Copy control for sales documents is not maintained".
actions: Enter transaction code /nVTLA in the command field and press Enter.
Select source document type QT and target document type OR, then double-click Item in the dialog structure.
Select item category entry TQR (or ZTQR) linked to OR and click Details.
Verify Routine (Header) is set to 001 and Routine (Item) is set to 002.
Set Copy Quantity to X (Copy quantity directly).
Set Pos./Neg. quantity to + (Positive quantity).
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and save your transport request.

fields.note: Directly copies item quantities from quotation to order
Maintains positive sign for order fulfillment

config_steps.step: Create Customer Master Data for Sold-to and Ship-to Parties
config_steps.where: BP -- SAP Business Partner /XD01 -- Create Customer (Transactional)
config_steps.values: BP Role FLCU01: Sales Area 1000/10/00 configured with shipping conditions and pricing procedure
config_steps.check: Run transaction XD03 or BP to verify that sales area data tabs are complete and active.
config_steps.why: Customer master records supply the mandatory partner functions, pricing schema, and shipping parameters needed to process free-of-charge quotations and deliveries.
config_steps.if_missing: If customer sales views are missing, quotations cannot be created and the system triggers error V1206 "Customer master record does not exist for the specified sales area".
actions: Enter transaction code /nBP in the command field and press Enter.
Click Organization and select grouping for external or internal customer numbering.
Fill in Name, Street, City, and Postal Code on the Address tab.
Switch role to FLCU00 (FI Customer) and fill in company code reconciliation account.
Switch role to FLCU01 (Customer Sales) and navigate to Sales Area tab.
Enter Sales Organization, Distribution Channel, and Division, then save the Business Partner.
Record the generated Customer / Business Partner number.

config_steps.step: Create Material Master Data for Free Sample Goods
config_steps.where: MM01 -- Create Material (Initial Screen) -- Logistics > Materials Management > Material Master > Material > MM01 - Create
config_steps.screen_title: Select Views: Basic Data 1, Sales: Sales Org. 1, MRP 1
config_steps.values: Material ZSAMPLE-01: FERT type, Item Category Group NORM, Sales views active in plant
config_steps.check: Run transaction MM03 to verify material master sales and plant views are fully created.
config_steps.why: The material master provides the physical attributes, weights, dimensions, and organizational data required for outbound delivery creation and inventory management during goods issue.
config_steps.if_missing: Without material master sales views, the material cannot be added to sales quotations, resulting in error message V1149 "Material ZSAMPLE-01 is not defined for sales organization 1000".
actions: Enter transaction code /nMM01 in the command field and press Enter.
Enter Material number (e.g. ZSAMPLE-01), Industry sector, and Material type (FERT or HALB).
Click Select Views and check Basic Data 1, Sales: Sales Org. 1, Sales: Sales Org. 2, Sales General/Plant, and MRP 1.
Enter Plant and Storage Location in the organizational levels pop-up window.
Enter Material Description, Base Unit of Measure (PC), and Item Category Group (NORM) on Sales views.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) to commit the material master record.

config_steps.step: Create Condition Records for Pricing and Discounts
config_steps.where: VK11 -- Create Condition Records -- Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Basic Functions > Pricing > Condition Records > VK11 - Create
config_steps.values: Condition record for ZSAMPLE-01: price established for customer/material combination
config_steps.check: Execute transaction VK13 to review condition record validity and scale details.
config_steps.why: Condition records drive automated price retrieval in sales documents, ensuring proper valuation before the 100% discount condition zeroes out the net value.
config_steps.if_missing: If condition records are missing, pricing analysis returns zeros, preventing accurate tracking of product cost and sample promotional value in SAP Profitability Analysis.
actions: Enter transaction code /nVK11 in the command field and press Enter.
Enter Condition Type (e.g. PR00 or ZR10) and press Enter.
Select key combination Sold-to Party / Material and click Execute.
Enter Customer number, Material code (ZSAMPLE-01), Rate (Amount or Percentage), and valid-from/to dates.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) to record the pricing condition table entry.

config_steps.step: Configure Shipping Point Determination and Plant Assignment
config_steps.where: OVXC -- SPRO > Enterprise Structure > Assignment > Logistics Execution > Assign shipping point to plant
config_steps.screen_title: Change View "Assign Shipping Point to Plant": Overview
config_steps.values: Plant 1000 linked to Shipping Point 1000
config_steps.check: Run transaction OVLP to verify shipping point determination rules for shipping conditions and loading groups.
config_steps.why: Shipping point determination is critical for the hand-off from OTC sales documents to Logistics Execution (LE) outbound deliveries and warehouse shipping tasks.
config_steps.if_missing: If shipping point determination fails, outbound delivery creation via VL01N fails with error VL385 "Shipping point could not be determined".
actions: Enter transaction code /nOVXC in the command field and press Enter.
Click New Entries or locate your Plant in the assignment table.
Assign the relevant Shipping Point (e.g. 1000) to your delivering Plant (e.g. 1000).
Click Save (Ctrl+S) and assign the configuration change to a transport request.

config_steps.step: Create Free-of-Charge Quotation Document
config_steps.where: VA21 -- Create Sales Quotation -- Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Quotation > VA21 - Create
config_steps.values: Quotation ZQT created for customer 100000 with material ZSAMPLE-01, zero net value
config_steps.check: Run transaction VA23 to display the created quotation and confirm document status and net value are zero.
config_steps.why: This operational step initiates the customer interaction lifecycle, locking in price, validity date, and free-of-charge terms in a legally binding offer.
config_steps.if_missing: If quotation creation fails due to incorrect master data or incomplete config, business users cannot issue valid offers, halting the pre-sales pipeline.
actions: Enter transaction code /nVA21 in the command field and press Enter.
Enter Quotation Type ZQT and press Enter.
Enter Sold-to Party, Ship-to Party, Customer Reference, and mandatory Quotation Valid-From and Valid-To dates.
Enter Material ZSAMPLE-01 and Order Quantity (e.g. 2 PC) in the Item Overview table.
Navigate to Item Details and verify item category is ZTQR and pricing is zero net value.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) to create the quotation and record the generated document number.

config_steps.step: Display and Verify Quotation Pricing and Validity Dates
config_steps.where: VA23 -- Display Sales Quotation -- Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Quotation > VA23 - Display
config_steps.values: Quotation inspected: validity period active, net value verified as 0.00
config_steps.check: Confirm that net value is 0.00 and pricing analysis displays condition ZR10 successfully applied.
config_steps.why: Verifying the quotation guarantees that all pricing discounts and validity parameters are correct before converting the offer into a live sales order.
config_steps.if_missing: Failure to verify pricing can lead to leakage where free samples are accidentally billed to the customer, creating billing disputes and credit memo rework.
actions: Enter transaction code /nVA23 in the command field and press Enter.
Enter the previously created Quotation number and press Enter.
Navigate to Header > Sales tab to review validity dates and customer reference data.
Select the item row, click Item Details, and verify pricing elements show discount condition ZR10 netting total to zero.
Click Back (F3) to exit the display screen.

config_steps.step: Create Subsequent Free-of-Charge Order with Reference
config_steps.where: VA01 -- Create Sales Order -- Logistics > Sales and Distribution > Sales > Order > VA01 - Create
config_steps.values: Sales order created referencing quotation, copying item ZTQR and quantity 2
config_steps.check: Run transaction VA03 to display the sales order and check document flow connecting quotation to order.
config_steps.why: This step converts the accepted pre-sales offer into an actionable fulfillment request, triggering inventory allocation and outbound logistics processing.
config_steps.if_missing: If order creation fails, downstream logistics execution cannot occur, preventing physical warehouse picking and shipping of the free sample.
actions: Enter transaction code /nVA01 in the command field and press Enter.
Enter Order Type OR (or customized free order type) and click Create with Reference button.
Switch to the Quotation tab in the pop-up window and enter the Quotation number.
Click Copy button to transfer items and header data from the quotation into the new sales order.
Verify copied quantities, shipping point, and zero net value in the item overview.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) to create the sales order and record the order number.

config_steps.step: Create Outbound Delivery for Free-of-Charge Order
config_steps.where: VL01N -- Create Outbound Delivery -- Logistics > Logistics Execution > Outbound Process > Goods Issue for Outbound Delivery > Outbound Delivery > Create > Single Document > VL01N - With Order Reference
config_steps.screen_title: Create Outbound Delivery with Order Reference
config_steps.values: Outbound delivery created for order, picking 2 PC of ZSAMPLE-01 from plant 1000
config_steps.check: Run transaction VL03N to display the outbound delivery document and verify status.
config_steps.why: The outbound delivery hand-off initiates Logistics Execution, creating warehouse tasks and inventory reservations for the physical picking and packing of sample stock.
config_steps.if_missing: Without an outbound delivery, physical stock cannot be issued from inventory, breaking the fulfillment chain and stalling warehouse operations.
actions: Enter transaction code /nVL01N in the command field and press Enter.
Enter Shipping Point (e.g. 1000) and Sales Order number.
Press Enter to load line items into the delivery workspace.
Verify picked quantity matches order quantity (e.g. 2 PC).
Click Save (Ctrl+S) to generate the outbound delivery document and record the delivery number.

config_steps.step: Post Goods Issue for Free-of-Charge Order Delivery
config_steps.where: VL02N -- Change Outbound Delivery -- Logistics > Logistics Execution > Outbound Process > Goods Issue for Outbound Delivery > Outbound Delivery > VL02N - Change
config_steps.values: Goods Issue posted: inventory updated, material document generated, accounting entries recorded for sample cost
config_steps.check: Check document flow in VA03 or VL03N to ensure Goods Issue status is completely processed (C).
config_steps.why: Posting goods issue reduces physical stock in inventory and hands off cost accounting data to Financial Accounting (FI) and Controlling (CO) as a sample promotional expense.
config_steps.if_missing: If goods issue fails, inventory remains uncleared and subsequent document status checks in OTC show pending fulfillment, preventing financial closure.
actions: Enter transaction code /nVL02N in the command field and press Enter.
Enter the Outbound Delivery number and press Enter.
Click Post Goods Issue button in the application toolbar.
Observe status bar message confirming goods issue was posted successfully.
Click Save (Ctrl+S) if any uncommitted header changes remain.

production_issues.title: Validity Period Expiration Blocks Subsequent Sales Order Creation
production_issues.applies_to: Standard Quotation; Value-Based Quotation; Free-of-Charge Quotation
production_issues.symptom: Users report that they cannot create a sales order referencing an existing quotation because the system throws an error stating that the validity period has expired.
production_issues.impact: Order fulfillment is halted, leading to delayed revenue recognition and lost sales opportunities if customers miss their pricing windows.
production_issues.how_to_find: Execute transaction VA23 to view the quotation header details, check the valid-to date in field VBUK-AUTLF or VBKD-ANGDT, and attempt reference creation via VA01.
production_issues.root_cause: The quotation valid-to date (VBKD-BNDDT) has passed, and standard pricing or availability logic prevents order creation from expired documents without explicit date extension or re-quotation.
production_issues.verify: Create a new sales order via transaction VA01 referencing the updated quotation to confirm the system allows conversion without error.
production_issues.prevent: Implement an automated batch job using SAP Application Interface Framework or custom background monitoring to alert sales representatives 14 days before quotation expiration.
production_issues.ref_title: SAP Help Portal: Quotations in Sales

g1|panel|inquiry and quotation.otc_impact: The Inquiry and Quotation family initiates the Order-to-Cash value chain by capturing pre-sales demand, locking in pricing and inventory commitments, and converting qualified leads into binding sales orders. For the customer, it provides pricing transparency and contractual certainty while establishing strict credit and availability guardrails before order placement. In SAP S/4HANA, these SD documents integrate directly with credit management, material availability checks (ATP), and pricing procedures to protect downstream cash flow and eliminate downstream fulfilment friction.

panel_qa.question: Why should we use Quotations instead of creating Sales Orders directly for all customer requests?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Inquiry and quotation processing provides a legally binding pre-sales framework that protects company margins without committing physical inventory or generating financial liabilities. SAP handles this via sales document category A for inquiries and B for quotations, which execute dynamic availability checks (ATP) and pricing without triggering delivery creation or accounting postings. This approach safeguards inventory, reduces order cancellation rates, and maintains clean audit trails for revenue forecasting. Next, we will review how validity dates enforce strict commercial boundaries. The weak answer is that sales orders take too long to create so quotations are just faster drafts.
panel_qa.trap: The weak answer is that sales orders take too long to create so quotations are just faster drafts.

panel_qa.question: How do we handle value-based and free-of-charge quotations without compromising our standard pricing and tax controls?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Value-based quotations aggregate total anticipated order value across variable product lines, while free-of-charge quotations use dedicated pricing procedures to zero out net prices while preserving cost accounting visibility. In S/4HANA, this is configured via sales document types IQ (Inquiry), QT (Quotation), WV (Value Quotation), and FQ (Free-of-Charge Quotation) mapped to specific pricing procedures like RVAA01. This configuration ensures accurate profitability analysis via Margin Analysis (CO-PA) while preventing unauthorized revenue leakage. Next, we will validate the pricing condition exclusion groups. The weak answer is that we manually delete prices on the quotation item level whenever items are free.
panel_qa.trap: The weak answer is that we manually delete prices on the quotation item level whenever items are free.

panel_qa.question: What happens to open inventory and credit exposure when a customer accepts a quotation?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Quotation conversion transfers the pre-sales commitment into a sales order through standard copy control routines that update document flow and release reserved ATP quantities. SAP uses copy control from header (VTAA) and item (VTLA) level to map requirement types from quotation categories (e.g., requirement class 011 for standard quotations) to sales order requirement classes. This mechanism updates available-to-promise stock and feeds open commitments into SAP Credit Management (FI-CR). Next, we will configure automatic expiration jobs to clear stale commitments. The weak answer is that quotations hold inventory indefinitely until someone manually deletes them.
panel_qa.trap: The weak answer is that quotations hold inventory indefinitely until someone manually deletes them.

panel_qa.question: How do we prevent expired quotations from being converted into binding sales orders after price lists have changed?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Quotation validity dates must be strictly enforced through copy control date checks and automated background jobs that set rejection reasons on past-due documents. In SAP S/4HANA, copy control routine 051 (Check validity period) assigned in transaction VTLA prevents creation of sales orders when sy-datum exceeds the quotation valid-to date (VBAK-ANGDT to VBAK-BNDDT). This control protects gross margins against inflationary price shifts and raw material cost spikes. Next, we will implement SAP job schedule template SAP_SD_QUOT_SQUE to mass-reject expired records. The weak answer is that sales reps can override any date check if the customer threatens to walk away.

panel_qa.question: How do inquiries and quotations integrate with SAP S/4HANA Sales pricing and external CPQ engines?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Pre-sales documents execute standard S/4HANA pricing conditions (PR00, taxes, rebates) or ingest complex configurable bundles from external CPQ tools via SAP API Business Hub services. SAP uses condition technique architecture in pricing procedure RVAA01 to determine net value, feeding conditions into the document pricing element table PRCD_ELEMENTS. This integration ensures unified pricing logic across e-commerce, CPQ, and direct sales channels. Next, we will monitor integration error logs via transaction AIF. The weak answer is that pricing is hardcoded in quotations and recalculated from scratch when the order is placed.

panel_qa.question: What metrics should we track to measure the effectiveness of our quotation-to-order conversion process?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: We measure quote-to-order conversion rate, average quotation cycle time, and value of expired quotations using SAP Fiori analytical apps and embedded analytics. SAP leverages CDS views such as C_SalesDocumentItemQuery to calculate win rates by sales organization, customer, and product category. Tracking these metrics uncovers pricing competitiveness issues and sales force bottlenecks before they impact actual revenue achievement. Next, we will build custom KPI tiles for the Sales Manager dashboard. The weak answer is that we only track total billed revenue and ignore pre-sales conversion metrics.
